aiResearchSummary.text: Cellino is researching platforms and systems for automated cell culture, as described in 'Platforms and systems for automated cell culture,' which detail cell culture containers, imaging subsystems, and computing subsystems for processing cell cultures. Additionally, 'Systems and methods for cell manufacturing' outlines processes for culturing cells on specialized surfaces, while 'Microfluidic laser-activated intracellular delivery systems and methods' focuses on laser-based intracellular delivery. These efforts target automated, scalable cell therapy manufacturing.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Cellino combines Nebula™ platform with AI-driven optical bioprocess.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
